'''2018 MPC Cal Aldred LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cal Aldred]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Cal Aldred]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
